about: The generator's constellation (tools/shf/dummyTLE.js, shell table of 2026-09-30) scanned by the flare engine (hash 14a817f5c008) on 12 latitudes x 24 nights of 2026 (every 15 days from 8 January) x 3 longitudes (0, 120, 240): the simulated year the dated-planes model is checked against. years: per latitude and kind [lat, sum, se] = the sum over the 24 nights of the mean over the 3 longitudes, and its standard error from the longitude scatter. nights: single nights [lat, date, mean, sd] (both kinds) where the sum over the 3 longitudes is large AND the model agreed within 2% when the fixture was built: they are regression anchors (a change that moves them by more than the tolerance is a change in the model), not a measure of the model's typical error, which is in the 'years' sums and in tools/shf/stats/README.md. The night at each longitude is a different night (the planes drift against the Sun between one longitude's noon and the next), so the 3-longitude mean is what the model's longitude mean is compared with. The model's ratios when the fixture was frozen: year sums 0.990-1.006 (visible) and 0.987-1.003 (all); the chosen nights within 3% (45°N 20 October: -2.1% both kinds; the others within 1.1%).
